scope: Capture the live SR10.4 File Manager down-stepper while the left button is visibly over it and held, then compare the transition with the installed GTK2 assets.

method.input_route: Host XTest via xdotool into the authenticated MAME window; no direct port override.
method.guest_pointer_target: Native frame shows pointer hotspot over the File Manager vertical down arrow before the hold.
method.scroll_position: The thumb was at the lower end of the track. Whether VUE considers the arrow enabled at this endpoint is not established.

result: With File Manager already active, the live down-arrow hold produced 37 visible pixel changes. All 37 match the SR10.4 held/released transition at the same glyph coordinates and with the exact #3e536e/#c4d5ed color swaps used by the installed GTK2 15x15 normal/pressed assets. The other 16 expected transition pixels are not visible under the cursor. This validates the observed part of the live down-arrow relief; it does not establish its enabled state at the track endpoint or validate other directions/states.

cleanup.mame_window: Iconic, restored to the pre-test state

next: Keep the proven down-arrow relief and exact normal horizontal-cell results. Continue I167 only for the still-unverified GTK2 states/directions; do not alter normal geometry or KDE-role colors without a measured mismatch.
